verdict.rationale: Statsig plausibly could offer an isolated test environment, but the evidence pack never documents one: no dev/staging environments, test API keys, or a sandbox project separated from production data. The related items describe different things. Target apps scope configs to applications within a single project, overrides force specific users into variants for QA, and offline AI evals grade outputs on a fixed test set; none of these is an isolated sandbox environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
